decisions.reason: The source adds image and information presentation in Rabby's wallet NFT view; it does not change whether successfully minted NFTs are listed accurately on the dashboard.
The wallet presentation issue does not change the dashboard requirement to display referrals, tickets, and prizes.
Displaying an NFT image and information in Rabby does not alter public mint or next-draw statistics.
The source does not specify any change to the NFT's Small Block ticket metadata attributes; it only addresses their general presentation in a wallet.
The Rabby wallet display requirement does not change how fiat buyers access commissions, tickets, prizes, or reward guidance.
The source concerns NFT presentation inside Rabby and does not modify certificate-email contents or ebook read actions.
The source's mention of a planned ETH test does not change the deferred Transak fiat-mint provider, payment methods, or mint flow.
The observed lack of image and information in Rabby does not direct any change to the approved FAQ copy.
The source concerns presentation of an existing NFT in Rabby and does not change background wallet creation or custody requirements for fiat buyers.
NFT artwork presentation in Rabby is independent of the landing-page book-cover size, crop, placement, and visibility requirements.
The wallet display issue does not revise any About-page copy or its description of project mechanics.
Requiring Rabby to show the NFT's image and information does not alter the mint-number referral-code identity or its required display locations.
